intel: ipu3: Clear mPostProcessBufs if process type is not rotate When the process type is not PROCESS_ROTATE, the mPostProcessBufs[0] is the input buffer. It must be released after it has been used. If it isn't released, the mPostProcessBufs will be continuous increased in some cases. One case is the YUV down scaling. sepolicy: add rules and labels for journald List of changes: - Create type for journald executable and conf file. - Get rename cros_run_systemd_journal to cros_run_journal. Label /run/log with it. - Support rsyslogd creating its socket in /run/systemd/journal - Modify the log_writter macro to support logging to journald. This also let us get rid of explicit support for it in cros_chapsd. - Create cros_journald.te file with some of the policies needed by journald. This is only a starting point and is still in permissive mode. - Get rid of explicit "allow cros_rsyslogd cros_run:dir search". r_dir_perms are allowed for everything in the chromeos_domain. - Create /run/systemd/journal with permissions allowing rsyslogd to create its socket. While a non-selinux change, this was only required after selinux policy started being enforced on rsyslogd. - Fix typo, changing /dev/logger to /dev/log. This line doesn't have an effect on the system, but adding it satisfies some linter checks.
